## This repository accepts Issues only

UNRESOLVED player feedback belongs in the structured GitHub Issue forms.
Code, assets, story content, configuration and documentation contributions are
not accepted in this public tracker, and pull requests will be closed without
merging.

- [Report a bug](https://github.com/yushirm/unresolved-feedback/issues/new?template=bug.yml)
- [Share general feedback](https://github.com/yushirm/unresolved-feedback/issues/new?template=feedback.yml)
